prompt:
REDRAW THE SCROLL FORMATION MAGE IN IMAGE2 to truly match IMAGE1's game-character proportions and image3's project GEM ICON visual language. User has rejected two subtle ratio retouches as still not unified. Make a decisive full redraw, not another tiny resize.

IMAGE1 (archer) is the PRIMARY authority for actual head-to-body relationship, head WIDTH, broad expressive face scale, line weight and simplified clothing volumes.
IMAGE2 (scroll mage) gives the ONLY identity/design/pose to preserve.
IMAGE3 gives big matte painted planes and clear darker side versus lit face, not literal crystal material or blue color.

STRONG PROPORTION CORRECTION:
The mage's real head/face must be much more substantial relative to torso and legs, exactly in the spirit of image1. About 3.5–4 anatomical head heights crown-to-sole, excluding feather ornament and scroll. Enlarge actual skull/face width AND height by around 25 percent compared with image2 relative to the body, shorten neck, compact torso, shorten both thighs and shins evenly about 15 percent. Retain her clearly ADULT face and graceful natural build; no baby cheeks, huge forehead or thick swollen limbs. Hands/feet substantial enough for a readable stylized game character.
The intended silhouette is compact and graphic like the archer, not a long-legged fashion illustration. Do not count the long feather or scroll as part of the head/body ratio. Do not merely zoom the entire image or enlarge accessories.

LOCK THE CHOSEN DESIGN:
Same teal asymmetrical bob and broad ivory forelock, small flower pin, single feather ornament, green eyes, calm slightly lowered front THREE-QUARTER LEFT face. Same rounded black cloud shoulder with ivory scalloped edge, gold fastener, ivory chest facing, dark waist sash and OVAL jade buckle, ivory-lined rounded cuffs, selected long curved black wrap skirt/ivory underlap, two broad rounded teal cloud-marked tails, original boots. Same tastefully opaque outfit coverage, no added exposure or shape redesign.
Same one hand thoughtfully near chin and other holding the continuous large calligraphy brush toward screen-right; fit these gestures anatomically to shorter arms/torso, correct hand grip.
Keep giant two-roller landscape scroll behind her and original broad arc/turn; left paper is continuous with NO black internal divider. Scroll remains a defining large prop but does not force the human figure's head to become tiny.

GEM ICON REPAINT — NOT JUST RATIO:
Hair in 3–4 broad sculpted teal locks, each one mid-tone plane, one deep shadow plane and one restrained lighter plane. No fine strands or continuous glossy highlight ribbons.
Robe, sleeves and tail panels use 2–3 LARGE coherent light/shadow groups, bolder dark edges and substantial folded forms matching image1. Integrate tiny old folds into larger shapes; keep broad quiet blacks/ivories/teals.
Rollers, brush and waist jewel simplified into strong readable volumes. No tiny shiny metal edges everywhere.
Scroll painting reduced to THREE broad gray mountain groups and TWO simple birds with ample quiet ivory paper, no dense repeated cloud and mountain texture across every inch. Keep actual scroll shape/identity.
Face simple graphic adult eyes and two-tone warm skin, not realistic iris or thin-line anime beauty painting. No polygon triangles on skin. Clean mature expression without fine makeup/wrinkles.
No grain, speckle, dense triangle mosaic, 3D jewelry gloss, photorealism or unstructured watercolor blur. Strong controlled contour, large matte color planes and compact character volumes.

ONE full-body mage only, on plain warm ivory square background, complete feather, scroll ends, brush tip and both feet safely within margin. No archer in output, no side-by-side panel, text or frame.
